help_text:
🐾 Welcome to the game! 🐾

This Web3 gaming framework allows you to support Gery, the mountain cat.

🎯 How does it work?
1. Click the I support Gery, the mountain cat button
2. Enter the amount you wish to support in tBNB. The minimum amount you can select is 0.005 tBNB.
3. Click the ‘PAY AND START’ button. This connects the platform to your wallet and authorises the payment.
4. Once the payment has been confirmed on the blockchain, you’ll be taken straight to the game menu.
5. Choose games and collect as many points as possible!
6. You can finish the games by clicking on the ⬆ button.
7. Click on the leaderboard to see where you rank amongst the players.
📌 Every game has a different multiplier! 📌

🐱 Have fun! 🐱
